items.title: Robot platform combines AI and rapid imaging to improve perovskite solar cell fabrication
items.excerpt: University of Osaka researchers built an automated robotic platform that records antisolvent droplet behavior during perovskite film fabrication; machine learning sorted the variables to find an optimal processing window, yielding a 24.4%-efficient cell (ACS Nano).

items.title: Humanoid AI connects walking and object handling without demonstrations of complete task sequences
items.excerpt: Seoul National University's RISE vision-language-action model learns locomotion and manipulation from separately collected data and chains them into multistep tasks, scoring 87.3% vs 73.6% for a GR00T baseline in simulation and 50% vs 30% on a real Unitree G1 (IROS 2026).

items.title: AI slays the dragon as four agents conquer Minecraft without human intervention
items.excerpt: A Google DeepMind preprint reports four Gemini 4 Argon agents, given only the goal of defeating the Ender Dragon, finished Minecraft in one ~27-hour run by coordinating via in-game chat and self-written code, with 605 deaths along the way.

items.title: Machine learning simulations reveal how plastic transforms into hard carbon
items.excerpt: Oxford chemists used machine-learning-driven atomistic simulations with quantum-mechanical accuracy to follow PVDC as it is heated, showing how five- and seven-membered carbon rings form and keep the material from ordering into graphite (Chemical Science) — relevant to battery anode hard carbon.

items.title: Why do people prefer human empathy despite rating AI empathy higher?
items.excerpt: Penn State researchers found participants rated AI-written empathetic replies higher in quality than human ones yet still chose human empathizers when given the choice, with perceived effort driving empathy ratings (Communications Psychology).

items.title: Automated platform optimizes enzyme production using cell-free protein synthesis and AI-driven design
items.excerpt: Fraunhofer IZI-BB's ZenBio platform produces enzyme variants by cell-free protein synthesis, measures them under harsh conditions, and lets an AI learn sequence-property links to propose the next design round; a robotic station for 1,500 parallel variants is planned.

items.title: 10 minutes is all it takes for AI assistance to erode your motivation, study shows
items.excerpt: In problem-solving experiments, people who used AI to get answers were more likely to give up and fail once that help was removed than people who never used it.

items.title: Could AI ever build itself? Scientists map the road to the 'last AI built by humans.'
items.excerpt: Researchers lay out what recursive self-improvement — AI systems automating AI research — would require, and whether it is viable as a way to tame soaring model-development costs.

items.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence
items.excerpt: MIT professors Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins were recognized with the Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for their work on AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, including deep-learning-found compounds such as halicin.

items.title: Making machines that can listen
items.excerpt: MIT professor Paris Smaragdis works on machines that hear and understand sounds the way humans do, aiming to improve artificial auditory perception across applications.

items.title: Q&A: How AI came to model the "messy" human mind
items.excerpt: MIT assistant professor Benjamin Lindquist discusses his research on how randomness and irrationality were built into early AI models designed to mimic human creativity and cognition.

items.title: Gothenburg and Chalmers Researchers Develop Modular Graph Neural Decoder for Surface Code Memory and Lattice Surgery
items.excerpt: University of Gothenburg and Chalmers researchers built a modular graph-neural-network decoder for surface-code quantum error correction that handles both memory and lattice-surgery operations and outperforms traditional decoders.

items.title: FAU Researchers Test Quantum Machine Learning for Lung Cancer Prediction
items.excerpt: Florida Atlantic University researchers benchmarked quantum machine learning methods for lung cancer prediction, with a D-Wave annealing approach reaching 91.90% accuracy on real quantum hardware.

items.title: Sentira Brings Claude's AI to 10x Genomics' Chromium Platform
items.excerpt: 10x Genomics launched Sentira, an Anthropic Claude-powered AI platform designed to accelerate analysis of single-cell data from its Chromium instruments.

items.title: 100 Million-Cell AI-Ready Dataset with Single-Cell and Proteomic Data Created by Parse and Nomic
items.excerpt: Parse Biosciences and Nomic Bio are building Cascade, a 100-million-cell multimodal, time-resolved dataset combining single-cell and proteomic data to train AI models of immune response.

items.title: To detect deepfake videos, researchers turn to the physics of light
items.excerpt: A new optical technique for spotting deepfake videos claims 97.8% accuracy while using less energy than digital neural networks of similar performance.

items.title: How to tell if a voice recording is AI-generated
items.excerpt: Voices can be cloned in seconds; Scientific American explains the acoustic and research-backed tells that help distinguish real speech from AI-generated audio.

items.title: Using AI to Avoid Thinking Harms Students
items.excerpt: Drawing on cognitive-offloading research, the piece argues students facing a hard assignment learn more by asking AI or instructors for hints rather than answers.
